references.prompt: Spring tile: a single flat-sided hexagonal diorama tile, 32 m across, lush meadow grass cap and the hexagon side walls show a thin grass lip over dark root-filled topsoil that darkens softly downward into a near-black foot, one continuous dark earth. Near the middle of the tile a small round spring pool about 12 m across sits in a shallow grassy hollow, ringed by weathered grey rocks, tussocks of reeds and rushes and a few water plants, clear water tinted pale turquoise in the shallows and deep teal-blue where deep, sun glints, soft caustics on the shallow bed, a pale pebbly floor showing through the water and a gentle ring of ripples where the spring wells up. An 8 m wide river runs out of the pool to the middle of one flat edge of the tile in a channel sunk below the meadow surface between natural earthy banks with pebbles and reeds. Where the river reaches the tile side wall, the hexagon side wall shows the water column in cross-section like clear tinted resin, turquoise at the top fading to deep blue at the bottom, never an empty gap. The rest of the tile is open meadow grass, stylized-real diorama miniature, real PBR materials, slightly exaggerated proportions, soft noon sun, neutral grey studio background, 35 degree three-quarter view
